title.narrative: Integrated services and humanitarian assistance for vulnerable Rohingya Communities in Cox's Bazar Bangladesh.

description.narrative: Outcome: Increased health, agency, and dignity through improved protection, WASH and nutrition.

The overall objective is to contribute to the improvement of the living conditions and access to basic services of Rohingya refugee population in Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh by increased health, agency, and dignity through improved protection, WASH and nutrition.

Total Participants : 41834. In line with the Joint Resilience Project (JRP), the main target group of the proposed action are Rohingya refugees. However, given the mixed nature of the refugee settlements in Teknaf Upazila, the needs of the most vulnerable member of the host communities will be taken into account. The Alliance2015 partners will comply with the Inter Sector Cooperation Group (ISCG) sector-specific guidelines on support to the host communities (published in May 2018), especially with regards to protection mainstreaming, do no harm principles and conflict sensitive programming.
